blocks.text: The Melissa & Doug Super Smile Dentist Kit is a 25-piece play set packed with everything kids need to explore the world of dentistry pretend play. Featuring an oversized set of teeth with four removable molars, these preschool classroom must haves let children practice cleaning, treating cavities with stickers, and even fitting retainers and braces, with instruments in a realistic toddler doctor play set that includes a vibrating tool with interchangeable drill and polisher heads, a toothbrush, toothpaste, floss, dental rinse, gauze pads, and more, for a true-to-life play experience. For more thrilling role play, combine this with the Melissa and Doug ice cream set, a toy vending machine & a kids kitchen playset to create the ultimate pretend play world! For 35+ years, Melissa and Doug has crafted imaginative preschool toys and durable wooden toys built to nurture childhood wonder, with everything from a life-sized grocery store playset to a play kitchen playset and play food to serve plush toys & puppets, to costumes, arts & crafts, and road trip activities for kids. It’s the kind of kid-powered play that builds independence and confidence!

items.label: Complete Dentist Play Set
items.value: Featuring oversized teeth & big, chunky dental tools—a vibrating drill & polisher, cavity stickers, floss, wiggly teeth, braces & more—just like in a real dental office

items.label: Skill-Building Pretend Play Toys
items.value: Kids can role play teeth cleaning, putting on braces & even tooth extractions, with premium-quality dentist toys, that will complement any doctor kit for preschoolers 3-5

items.label: Open-Ended, Screen-Free Play
items.value: Teaches dental hygiene & preschool learning activities—counting, hand-eye coordination, memory & empathy—using kids' dress up & pretend play to keep them active & engaged

items.label: Educational Toys for Any Occasion
items.value: When buying a birthday gift & holiday gifts for kids, or rewarding little milestones, celebrate the moments that matter with Melissa and Doug toys for boys & girls

items.label: Wholesome Play for 35+ Years
items.value: Melissa & Doug inspires kid-powered play with its learning toys for kids, baby & toddler toys, puzzles, games, building toys & stuffed animals, dolls, & even a doll house

items.label: Included Components
